prompt: Flatten a list of Optionals with Optional.stream, total the values that are present, and resolve a host name through two maps with a flatMap chain. Complete OptionalFlattener.
explanation: Optional.stream() is the bridge between the two APIs: it yields zero or one element, so flatMapping a stream of Optionals drops the empties without a single isPresent check. flatMap on Optional itself does the matching job for chained lookups -- the lambda returns another Optional, and a miss anywhere short-circuits the rest of the chain to empty. Wrapping each map.get in Optional.ofNullable is what turns a possible null into that empty.
hints: presentValues: stream the list and flatMap each Optional through its own stream() method -- a present one yields a single element, an empty one yields nothing -- then collect the survivors into a list.
totalLength can reuse the same flatMap and finish with .mapToInt(String::length).sum().
resolve is two chained flatMaps; use map(...) by mistake and you will end up with an Optional<Optional<String>> that does not compile.
